## 2. Preprocessing the series

```{r}

read_fred_csv <- function(filename, col_name) {
  path <- file.path("data", filename)
  if(!file.exists(path)) {
    warning("File mancante: ", path)
    return(NULL)
  }
  df <- read.csv(path, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  dates <- as.Date(df[,1], tryFormats = c("%Y-%m-%d","%d/%m/%Y","%Y/%m/%d"))
  values <- as.numeric(df[,2])
  clean <- na.omit(data.frame(Date = dates, Value = values))
  if(nrow(clean) == 0) return(NULL)
  xts_obj <- xts(clean$Value, order.by = clean$Date)
  colnames(xts_obj) <- col_name
  return(xts_obj)
}

UMCSENT  <- read_fred_csv("UMCSENT.csv",  "Sentiment")
WTISPLC  <- read_fred_csv("WTISPLC.csv",  "Oil")
PI       <- read_fred_csv("PI.csv",       "Income")
CPIAUCSL <- read_fred_csv("CPIAUCSL.csv", "CPI")
UNRATE   <- read_fred_csv("UNRATE.csv",   "Unrate")
INDPRO   <- read_fred_csv("INDPRO.csv",   "IndPro")
FEDFUNDS <- read_fred_csv("FEDFUNDS.csv", "FedFunds")

series_list <- list(
  UMCSENT, WTISPLC, PI, CPIAUCSL,
  UNRATE, INDPRO, FEDFUNDS
)

series_list <- series_list[!sapply(series_list, is.null)]

#merging the series
merged_data <- Reduce(function(x, y) merge(x, y, all = TRUE), series_list)
merged_data_1978 <- merged_data["1978/"]
nrow(merged_data_1978)
start(merged_data_1978)
end(merged_data_1978)

head(merged_data)

#log transformation
merged_data_1978$log_Sentiment <- log(merged_data_1978$Sentiment)
merged_data_1978$log_Oil       <- log(merged_data_1978$Oil)
merged_data_1978$log_Income    <- log(merged_data_1978$Income)
merged_data_1978$log_CPI       <- log(merged_data_1978$CPI)
merged_data_1978$IndPro <- as.numeric(merged_data_1978$IndPro)
merged_data_1978$log_IndProd   <- log(merged_data_1978$IndPro)

merged_data_1978$d_Sentiment <- diff(merged_data_1978$log_Sentiment)
merged_data_1978$d_Oil       <- diff(merged_data_1978$log_Oil)
merged_data_1978$d_Income    <- diff(merged_data_1978$log_Income)
merged_data_1978$d_CPI       <- diff(merged_data_1978$log_CPI)
merged_data_1978$d_IndProd   <- diff(merged_data_1978$log_IndProd)
merged_data_1978$d_Unrate    <- diff(merged_data_1978$Unrate)
merged_data_1978$d_FedFunds  <- diff(merged_data_1978$FedFunds)
head(merged_data_1978)

# scaling distributions
colonne_da_scalare <- c("log_Sentiment", "log_Oil", "log_Income", "log_CPI", "log_IndProd", "Unrate", "FedFunds")
df_scaled_converted <- merged_data_1978 %>%
  timetk::tk_tbl(rename_index = "Date") %>% 
  

select(Date, log_Sentiment, log_Oil, log_Income, log_CPI, log_IndProd, Unrate, FedFunds) %>%
  
mutate(
    across(
      .cols = all_of(colonne_da_scalare), 
      .fns = ~as.numeric(scale(.)) 
    )
  )

df_numeric <- df_scaled_converted %>%
  select(-Date) 

df_numeric_imputed <- df_numeric %>%
  fill(everything(), .direction = "down") 

colSums(is.na(df_numeric_imputed))

ts_data <- ts(df_numeric_imputed, start = c(1978, 1), frequency = 12)

head(ts_data)

df_diff <- merged_data_1978[, c("d_Sentiment", "d_Oil", "d_Income", "d_CPI", 
                                "d_IndProd", "d_Unrate", "d_FedFunds")]

df_diff_clean <- na.omit(df_diff)

ts_diff <- ts(df_diff_clean, start = c(1978, 2), frequency = 12)

head(ts_diff)

```

```{r}
vif_diff <- car::vif(lm_check_diff)
```

## 4. Splitting training and test samples
```{r}

n_obs_diff <- nrow(ts_diff)
split_point <- floor(0.80 * n_obs_diff)

train_ts_diff <- window(ts_diff, end = c(time(ts_diff)[split_point]))
test_ts_diff  <- window(ts_diff, start = c(time(ts_diff)[split_point + 1]))

train_y <- train_ts_diff[, "d_Sentiment"]
train_x <- train_ts_diff[, c("d_Oil", "d_Income", "d_CPI", "d_IndProd", "d_Unrate", "d_FedFunds")]

test_y <- test_ts_diff[, "d_Sentiment"]
test_x <- test_ts_diff[, c("d_Oil", "d_Income", "d_CPI", "d_IndProd", "d_Unrate", "d_FedFunds")]
```

## 6.ARIMAX Model
```{r}

library(forecast)
library(dplyr)

#exogenous variables
xreg_cols <- c("d_Oil", "d_Income", "d_CPI", "d_IndProd", "d_Unrate", "d_FedFunds")

data_matrix <- ts_diff 


n_train <- length(train_y)          
n_total <- nrow(data_matrix)        
n_forecast <- n_total - n_train     

forecasts_diff_arimax <- numeric(n_forecast)

cat("Avvio Rolling Window ARIMAX...\n")
cat("Finestra Training:", n_train, "mesi.\n")
cat("Previsioni da fare:", n_forecast, "\n")
cat("Attendi... la ristima di auto.arima ad ogni step può richiedere tempo.\n")

#Rolling window loop

pb <- txtProgressBar(min = 0, max = n_forecast, style = 3)

for (i in 1:n_forecast) {
  idx_start <- i
  idx_end   <- n_train + i - 1
  idx_pred  <- n_train + i  
  train_subset <- data_matrix[idx_start:idx_end, ]
  
  y_train_sub <- train_subset[, "d_Sentiment"]
  x_train_sub <- train_subset[, xreg_cols]
  
  x_future <- data_matrix[idx_pred, xreg_cols, drop = FALSE]
  fit_rolling <- tryCatch({
    auto.arima(y_train_sub, 
               xreg = x_train_sub, 
               seasonal = FALSE, 
               stepwise = TRUE,       
               approximation = FALSE) 
  }, error = function(e) return(NULL))
  if (!is.null(fit_rolling)) {
    fcast <- forecast(fit_rolling, xreg = x_future, h = 1)
    forecasts_diff_arimax[i] <- as.numeric(fcast$mean)
  } else {
    forecasts_diff_arimax[i] <- NA 
  }
  
  setTxtProgressBar(pb, i)
}
close(pb)
cat("\nRolling Window completata.\n")


#Results as levels 
idx_test_original <- (nrow(merged_data_1978) - n_forecast + 1):nrow(merged_data_1978)

actual_log_levels <- merged_data_1978$log_Sentiment[idx_test_original]


prev_log_levels <- merged_data_1978$log_Sentiment[idx_test_original - 1]

forecast_log_levels_arimax <- prev_log_levels + forecasts_diff_arimax


# Dataframe with results 

df_results_arimax <- data.frame(
  Date = index(actual_log_levels), 
  Actual_Log = as.numeric(actual_log_levels),
  Forecast_Log_ARIMAX = as.numeric(forecast_log_levels_arimax),
  Diff_Pred = forecasts_diff_arimax
)

# Plot
library(ggplot2)
ggplot(df_results_arimax, aes(x = Date)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Actual_Log, color = "Dati Reali"), size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Forecast_Log_ARIMAX, color = "ARIMAX Rolling"), size = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "ARIMAX Rolling Forecast vs Dati Reali",
       subtitle = "Modello sulle differenze, ricostruito sui livelli logaritmici",
       y = "Log(Consumer Sentiment)",
       color = "Legenda") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Dati Reali" = "black", "ARIMAX Rolling" = "blue")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

#RMSE Diagnostics 

rmse_arimax <- sqrt(mean((df_results_arimax$Actual_Log - df_results_arimax$Forecast_Log_ARIMAX)^2, na.rm = TRUE))
mae_arimax <- mean(abs(df_results_arimax$Actual_Log - df_results_arimax$Forecast_Log_ARIMAX), na.rm = TRUE)

cat("--- Performance ARIMAX (Rolling Window) ---\n")
cat("RMSE (Log Scale):", round(rmse_arimax, 4), "\n")
cat("MAE  (Log Scale):", round(mae_arimax, 4), "\n")
```



```{r}

# Stima del modello su TUTTO il dataset differenziato per controllo strutturale
# Usiamo le stesse variabili usate nel loop
fit_final_check <- auto.arima(data_matrix[, "d_Sentiment"], 
                              xreg = data_matrix[, xreg_cols],
                              seasonal = FALSE, stepwise = FALSE, approximation = FALSE)

cat("\n--- Diagnostica Strutturale (Modello su Dati Completi) ---\n")

# A. Check Residuals Automatico (Plot completi)
checkresiduals(fit_final_check)

#Jarque-Bera Test
res_final <- residuals(fit_final_check)
jb_test <- jarque.bera.test(res_final)

print(jb_test)
if(jb_test$p.value > 0.05) {
  cat("Normalità: I residui sono normali (p > 0.05).\n")
} else {
  cat("Normalità: I residui NON sono normali (spesso accade in finanza a causa di picchi/crisi).\n")
}

# ARCH test 
#Ljung-Box test
arch_check <- Box.test(res_final^2, lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")

cat("\n--- Test ARCH (Eteroschedasticità) ---\n")
if(arch_check$p.value > 0.05) {
  cat("Omoschedasticità: La varianza dei residui è costante (p > 0.05). Ottimo.\n")
} else {
  cat("Eteroschedasticità: La volatilità cambia nel tempo (p < 0.05). \nPotresti considerare un modello GARCH in futuro.\n")
}
```



```{r}

library(tseries)
library(ggplot2)
library(gridExtra)

# 1. Calcolo degli errori di previsione (Rolling)
# Errore = Valore Reale - Valore Previsto
rolling_residuals <- df_results_arimax$Actual_Log - df_results_arimax$Forecast_Log_ARIMAX

# Rimuoviamo eventuali NA (es. il primo dato se presente)
rolling_residuals <- na.omit(rolling_residuals)

# --- A. Visualizzazione Grafica ---
# Creiamo 3 grafici: Linea temporale, Istogramma, ACF

p1 <- ggplot(data.frame(Residui = rolling_residuals, Date = df_results_arimax$Date), aes(x = Date, y = Residui)) +
  geom_line() + geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Time Plot Residui (Rolling)", y = "Errore") + theme_minimal()

p2 <- ggplot(data.frame(Residui = rolling_residuals), aes(x = Residui)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), bins = 30, fill = "blue", alpha = 0.5) +
  stat_function(fun = dnorm, args = list(mean = mean(rolling_residuals), sd = sd(rolling_residuals)), color = "red") +
  labs(title = "Distribuzione Errori (Istogramma)", x = "Errore") + theme_minimal()

# Per l'ACF usiamo la funzione base di R perché ggplot è complesso per ACF
grid.arrange(p1, p2, nrow = 2)

# --- B. ACF Plot (Autocorrelazione) ---
# Se le barre superano le linee blu tratteggiate, c'è ancora informazione non catturata
acf(rolling_residuals, main = "ACF dei Residui di Previsione (Rolling)")

# --- C. Test di Ljung-Box ---
# H0: I residui sono rumore bianco (White Noise) -> MODELLO BUONO
# H1: C'è autocorrelazione -> MODELLO MIGLIORABILE
lb_test <- Box.test(rolling_residuals, lag = 12, type = "Ljung-Box")

print("--- Ljung-Box Test sui Residui Rolling ---")
print(lb_test)
if(lb_test$p.value > 0.05) {
  cat("OTTIMO: Non rifiutiamo H0. I residui sembrano White Noise (p > 0.05).\n")
} else {
  cat("ATTENZIONE: Rifiutiamo H0. C'è ancora autocorrelazione nei residui (p < 0.05).\n")
}
```
